title: A Website for Precision Manufacturing and Robotics
excerpt: How we built a modern web presence for Old World Labs, a precision manufacturing and robotics company pushing the boundaries of additive manufacturing, automation, and digital experiences.
challenge: Old World Labs offers three distinct service lines: advanced additive manufacturing at microscale precision, custom robotics and automation with AI-driven control systems, and Unreal Engine development for digital visualization. Communicating this range clearly — without diluting any single offering — was the core design challenge. The website had to speak to decision-makers in highly technical industries while remaining accessible to potential partners and collaborators.
solution: We designed and developed a modern, performance-first website that gives each service line its own space while maintaining a cohesive brand experience. Built on Next.js with static generation for fast load times and strong SEO. Key decisions included a dark-mode-first design language reflecting the precision engineering brand, structured service pages for technical audiences, and a lightweight architecture deployed on a global edge network delivering sub-second load times.
results: Dark-mode-first design language reflecting precision engineering brand
Sub-second load times on global edge network
Structured service pages for three distinct technical verticals
Scalable architecture for adding new services and case studies without changes
